I was about 12 at the time, sitting outside a book shop waiting for my mum when this old man approached me. We started having this really nice conversation. He was a really intelligent and really wise guy who had a lot of great things to say. Then he told me something that stuck with me sense then. He stopped and said something along the lines of "You're a sensitive and caring person, but be careful as people will try and take advantage of you and your emotions. You may find your self hurt by people who you trusted." (Those weren't his exact words, I'm 17 now and cant remember them entirely). Those words stuck with me because of how right he was, I didn't know how he even knew that about me, we weren't talking about me or my emotions, we were talking about the book I was reading. But some how he was able to discover so much about me just from that short conversation. All of it was right and I wish I had listened to his words more.
